gloss: to walk, to tread, to follow a path

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {歩|あゆ}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to walk, to go on foot
definitions.explanation: To walk at a steady, deliberate pace. More literary and dignified than the everyday verb 歩く.

definitions.gloss: to follow a path, to pursue a course in life
definitions.explanation: To progress through life or a career in a particular direction. Used figuratively for life paths, careers, and historical development.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧{歩|あゆ}む。
examples.english: To walk slowly along the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老人|ろうじん}→老人：03784_roujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{杖|つえ}→杖：12862_tsue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つき⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{歩|あゆ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: An elderly person was walking while leaning on a cane.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{夜道|よみち}→夜道：17541_yomichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{歩|あゆ}んだ。
examples.english: I walked alone along the dark night road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歩|あゆ}む。
examples.english: To follow the path one believes in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{音楽家|おんがくか}→音楽家：27511_ongakuka⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歩|あゆ}み⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: He began to pursue a path as a musician.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{共|とも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{歩|あゆ}んでいくべきだ。
examples.english: Both countries should walk together on the path toward peace.

notes:
USAGE:
A godan verb (conjugates {歩|あゆ}まない, {歩|あゆ}みます, {歩|あゆ}んで). More literary and dignified than ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧. In modern Japanese, the figurative sense (pursuing a life path) is more common than the literal walking sense. Often appears in written language, speeches, and formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歩|あゆ}む: to walk a path (literal and figurative)
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歩|あゆ}む: to walk through life
- {共|とも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{歩|あゆ}む: to walk together, to progress together
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歩|あゆ}み{出|だ}す: to take a new first step

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk (everyday, neutral)
- ⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to advance, to proceed (focuses on forward movement)
